note: Facts only. The daily 7AM-IST refresh rewrites this file; macro_events.py holds the logic and does all date math live (recurring prints, D-1/D-0 flags, the peace model). v2 keys: schedule, calendar, pending, sector_policy, earnings, sector_news, rbi_releases, index_members, rates. No personal names of officials anywhere (institution/role only).

dynamic.name: India-US trade deal (1st tranche)
dynamic.status: First tranche finalised and in legal drafting (commerce ministry, Oct 15); 'fine-tuning' after concluding most talks (Oct 26). Effective US tariff on Indian goods ~18% (penal Russia-oil tariff removed; IEEPA tariffs struck down Feb 2026). No signed text yet.
dynamic.watch: Joint statement / USTR notice; Indian-side pullback on agri-dairy; new US demands on tariffs

dynamic.name: Iran-US war (crude / Strait of Hormuz)
dynamic.status: Active: US naval blockade of Iranian ports, Hormuz constrained, Brent ~$110. A 7-day ceasefire proposal (blockade end, oil-sanction relief, Hormuz reopening, nuclear talks) is 'on the table'; the US administration rejected it and wants extra clauses; indirect talks continued through Oct 21.
dynamic.direction: Ceasefire → crude down → NIFTY up; Hormuz closure → crude spike → NIFTY down
dynamic.combined: See peace model for time-phased P(ceasefire/talks announced)
dynamic.watch: Brent crude is the real-time NIFTY channel (India imports ~85% oil)

peace_model.phase_note: 2nd ceasefire collapsed Jul 8; blockade + strikes since; 7-day ceasefire proposal under indirect negotiation (Oct)

pending.name: India–US trade deal: 1st tranche signed / published
pending.status: First tranche finalised and in legal drafting per the commerce ministry (Oct 15); both sides 'fine-tuning' after concluding most talks (Oct 26). US tariff on Indian goods already down to ~18% effective (penal Russia-oil tariff removed). Still no signed text — 'imminent' claims have slipped since July.
pending.direction: Signing → NIFTY ↑ (IT, pharma, textiles, gems, auto comps; INR ↑). Collapse / new US demands → ↓
pending.watch: Joint statement; USTR Federal Register notice; any Indian-side pullback on agri/dairy

pending.name: Iran–US ceasefire / Strait of Hormuz reopening
pending.status: 7-day ceasefire proposal (end of US naval blockade, oil-sanctions relief, Hormuz reopens day 6, talks day 7) remains 'on the table'; the US administration rejected it and is seeking extra clauses; indirect talks continue (Oct 21). Brent ~$110.
pending.direction: Ceasefire → crude ↓ → NIFTY ↑ (OMCs, paints, aviation, tyres ↑; ONGC/Oil India ↓). Hormuz escalation → crude spike → ↓
pending.watch: Brent is the real-time channel; any mediator-hosted round; blockade status

pending.name: RBI: further rupee-defence measures
pending.status: Oct 10 package = strongest action since 2013: special dollar window for state-run oil companies, a 20% Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve on large INR-derivative purchases, no re-booking of cancelled INR derivative contracts. USD/INR still ~95 (record low). Next steps historically: FCNR(B)/NRI deposit schemes, ECB easing, more derivative curbs.
pending.direction: New measures → INR ↑ short-term, ↑ importers/OMCs/airlines, banks neutral-to-↑; ↓ IT/pharma exporters marginally
pending.watch: RBI press releases after 17:00 IST; Friday FX-reserves print; forward premia

pending.name: RBI liquidity ops (OMO purchase / VRR) — or an off-cycle move
pending.status: Cash conditions tightened after the Oct 7 hike; RBI stepping up liquidity support as borrowing rates rise (Oct 27). Off-cycle rate action itself is a low-probability tail (~5%).
pending.direction: OMO/VRR → bond yields ↓, banks/NBFCs ↑. Off-cycle hike → ↓ rate-sensitives (realty, autos, NBFCs)
pending.watch: RBI 'Money Market Operations' + OMO calendar releases; overnight call vs repo

pending.name: Cabinet / CCEA Wednesday decisions (sector schemes)
pending.status: Recent: Green Energy Corridor-III ₹1.86 lakh cr + Rabi MSP 2027-28 (Sep 30); DAC cleared ₹2.12 lakh cr capital-acquisition proposals, 82% domestic (Oct 26). Pipeline talk: PLI tranches (electronics components, semis), EV-manufacturing policy applications, rail/metro projects, further Hormuz-linked energy steps.
pending.direction: Sector-specific ↑ on the approved theme (defence, T&D, renewables, rail, electronics)
pending.watch: Cabinet briefing ~16:00–17:00 IST on Wednesdays (PIB); DAC meets ~monthly

pending.name: Parliament Winter Session — dates + bill list
pending.status: Not yet announced (2025 session ran Dec 1–19; 2024 Nov 25–Dec 20). Announcement usually lands early–mid Nov; the legislative list is what moves sectors.
pending.direction: Depends on bills listed (financial-sector amendments, labour-code rollout, land/mining) — usually sector-specific, not index-level
pending.watch: Cabinet Committee on Parliamentary Affairs recommendation; PRS session alert

pending.name: US tariff / trade actions touching India (Section 232 / 301, post-IEEPA)
pending.status: IEEPA tariffs were struck down by the US Supreme Court (Feb 20, 2026) and terminated Feb 24; refunds via the Court of International Trade are ongoing. Section 232 pharma: 100% on patented drugs from Sep 29, generics/biosimilars excluded, India got 0% on select specialty drugs. New 232/301 actions (semis, services, remittances) remain the live risk.
pending.direction: New India-relevant duty → ↓ pharma/IT/textiles; relief bundled into the trade deal → ↑
pending.watch: Federal Register proclamations; Commerce Dept 232 investigations list

pending.name: Sugar/ethanol: ESY 2026-27 feedstock order + export policy
pending.status: OMC ethanol tender for the supply year starting Nov 1 excludes sugarcane-juice / B-heavy molasses ethanol (grain/maize/FCI-rice only), to protect domestic sugar supply; DGFT moved sugar exports to 'prohibited' (quota/TRQ exemptions only). Formal notifications and the 2026-27 export stance are the pending prints.
pending.direction: ↓ sugar mills (Balrampur, Shree Renuka, Dhampur, Triveni, Dalmia Sugar); ↑ grain-based distillers; neutral index
pending.watch: Food ministry / DFPD notifications; OMC tender allocation results; cane FRP

pending.name: SEBI board meeting / F&O weekly-expiry decision; LTCG-STT levy review
pending.status: SEBI has been working toward a consultation on ending weekly index-option expiries (glide path to monthly). Separately the finance ministry is seeking investor/expert views on LTCG and STT as it reviews capital-market levies (Oct 27) — a Budget FY28 input.
pending.direction: Weekly-expiry end → ↓ exchanges/brokers/depositories (BSE, Angel One, CDSL, MCX); a levy cut → ↑ the same names + sentiment
pending.watch: SEBI press releases (board meets ~quarterly); DEA consultation note

pending.name: 58th GST Council meeting (date TBA)
pending.status: 57th met Oct 8 (first in ~a year): blocked-ITC, inverted-duty refunds, registration simplification, post-GST-2.0 state revenue review. No next date announced; notice usually ~10 days ahead.
pending.direction: Rate/ITC changes are sector-specific (insurance, autos, cement, consumer durables, online gaming)

pending.name: India–EU FTA: EU Council approval for signature
pending.status: Concluded Jan 27, 2026; Commission has proposed it to the Council for signature (Sep); signing reportedly targeted Dec 16; European Parliament consent after → in force 2027. (India–UK FTA already in force since Jul 15, 2026.)
pending.direction: ↑ textiles, leather, gems, auto comps, chemicals, pharma (EU is India's #2 export market)

pending.name: OPEC+ 8-country monthly output decision
pending.status: The 8-member group meets monthly (usually the first weekend). With Hormuz constrained and Brent ~$110, quota changes move the crude channel directly.
pending.direction: Output hike → crude ↓ → NIFTY ↑ (OMCs, aviation, paints); cut/pause → ↓
pending.watch: OPEC press statement (Sunday evening IST) → Monday open

pending.name: Sovereign rating / outlook action on India
pending.status: Low-probability tail. Twin pressures (rupee at record low, oil import bill, calibrated tightening) are the arguments for a negative outlook; strong growth (Q1 FY27 +7.8%) and fiscal consolidation argue against.
